title: Night Market Poster and Reel
tests: Completes both linked deliverables from one message: a still poster and a matching animated reel, preserving exact event details in both.

faults.what: Every supplied reel frame contains a large, unwanted garbled headline and additional nonsense text behind the event details. The translucent dark panel does not hide this lettering, leaving overlapping text and an obviously unfinished appearance.
The illustrated stall signs contain garbled lettering rather than coherent signage.

judge.summary: The poster and animated reel share an appealing warm market illustration and correct event details, but prominent garbled background text makes the reel unsuitable for posting.

must_haves.item: Two separate finished assets are supplied: a still poster and an eight-second video reel, both vertical 9:16.
must_haves.why: A separate poster and an explicitly identified eight-second reel are supplied, both in approximately 9:16 vertical layouts.

must_haves.item: Both assets contain all five specified text strings, spelled exactly as requested.
must_haves.why: All five requested strings are readable in the poster and in each supplied reel frame.

must_haves.item: Both show warm illustrated food stalls and string lights with a visibly matching palette and design.
must_haves.why: Both use the same illustrated market scene with amber string lights, orange-red awnings, food counters, and a purple evening sky.

must_haves.item: The reel has visible background animation while all event details remain readable throughout.
must_haves.why: People's poses, steam, and light glows change across the sampled frames while the event text stays fixed and readable, although unwanted background lettering substantially clutters it.

must_haves.item: The reel has no audible sound.
must_haves.why: The supplied still frames provide no evidence about the audio track.
